about: The AI settings a site names itself, as both backends must read them: AI_FEATURES, AI_DAILY_LIMIT, AI_DAILY_LIMITS and AI_MODELS in .env (Node, loadAiSettings in server/config.ts), 'features', 'dailyLimit', 'dailyLimits' and 'models' in config.php's ai block (PHP, AiConfig). Replayed by tests/unit/ai-config.test.ts and php/tests/ConfigTest.php. `env` is the variable's value (null: not set), `php` the key's value; a row without one of them is the other backend's alone. A refusal names the setting and never repeats its value. The default and the most a site may set are AI_DAILY_LIMIT and AI_DAILY_LIMIT_MAX in src/shared/ai.ts: both tests hold these rows to them. A `dailyLimits` row may set the site's own number beside the pairs (`site`: AI_DAILY_LIMIT, 'dailyLimit'); an accepted one says which features end up with a number of their own (`limits`) and what every other feature gets (`others`), so a new feature changes no row. A `models` row (AI_MODELS, 'models') reads the same way: `site` is the site's own model (AI_MODEL, 'model'), `models` the features that end up with a model of their own, and every other feature gets the site's, or the provider's default.
